label: Cline CLI
description: One conversation with Cline CLI, Cline's coding agent: three conversations are three nodes. Wire `agent` and `stream` into an AskAgent and talk to it in a Loop; end the loop with a CloseBus on `stream`, which ends this node's part of the run. With no `computer`, Cline CLI runs on your machine (a local install only) with your own login, working in `folder`, from your own install of `cline` when there is one on PATH; when there is none, weft installs Cline CLI (with the Node.js 22 it runs on) itself, once, into a folder of its own shared by every program on the machine. With a `computer` wired, it is installed and run inside that computer, which a cloud install needs, and it logs in with the connection on `access`. weft drives Cline through the SDK its npm package carries. It asks before each call of its own tools, and a refusal fails only that tool; your program's tools never ask. When Cline has a question for you, it comes out of AskAgent as a question. Your program's tools reach Cline under their plain names, and one named like a tool of Cline's own (`read_files`, `run_commands`, `spawn_agent`, ...) takes that tool's place. On your machine's own login it is your own Cline: your login, the provider you last used, your plugins, rules and hooks. Its card shows what it is doing and a Start over button. What is exposed: the permission mode, the model and the reasoning effort; the rest of Cline's settings stay its own.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: A Computer to run Cline CLI in. Left out, it runs on your machine, which only a local install has. Several agents may share one computer.

inputs.name: access
inputs.description: A ClineCliAccess's `access`: a Cline API key, or a key for another provider Cline takes. Required with a `computer`. Left out on your machine, Cline CLI uses the login already on it.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.label: Folder
inputs.description: The folder Cline CLI works in. On your machine it is required, and must exist. In a computer it is a path inside the computer, its home folder when left out.

inputs.name: program
inputs.label: Program
inputs.description: On your machine: the Cline CLI program to run, when it is not the `cline` on your PATH or the one weft installs (an install of your own, a version you keep for this). A path on your machine, so it cannot go with a `computer`.

inputs.name: permission
inputs.label: Permissions
inputs.description: What Cline CLI may do without asking. `ask`: each call of Cline's own tools comes out of AskAgent as a question. `plan`: it reads and plans, and changes nothing. `bypass`: nothing asks, nothing is refused; for a computer, which is the wall around it.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: The model id to use, as its provider names it. Left out, the provider's default.

inputs.name: streamBy
inputs.label: Stream by
inputs.description: What goes out on `stream`: `message`, one event per whole message, tool use and result, so a run waiting on a long step sleeps; `token`, every piece of text as it is written too, which keeps the run awake while the agent writes.

inputs.name: effort
inputs.label: Reasoning effort
inputs.description: How hard the model reasons. Left out, what Cline is set to for the provider, else the model's default.

outputs.name: agent
outputs.description: The agent's handle: wire it into AskAgent's `agent`. Baked: made when the infra is started.

outputs.name: stream
outputs.description: Everything the agent does in this run, as AskAgent sends it. Wire it into every AskAgent of the loop, and into a CloseBus after the loop: the run's part of this node ends when it does.

then.message: ClineCli '{id}' runs on the machine weft runs on, which a cloud install does not have; wire a Computer into `computer`.
ClineCli '{id}' runs in a computer, where no login is waiting for it; give it a ClineCliAccess on `access`.
ClineCli '{id}' works on your machine, so it needs a `folder` to work in.
ClineCli '{id}' has a `permission` it does not know; pick one of ask, plan, bypass.
ClineCli '{id}' has a `streamBy` it does not know; pick message or token.
ClineCli '{id}' runs in a computer, where `program`, a path on your machine, means nothing; leave `program` out, the computer installs Cline CLI itself.
